materials.cover_letter:
I build systems that bridge technical complexity and real customer needs. That is the work I have done for seven years, and it is exactly what your Forward Deployed Engineer role demands.

At Redwood, I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation workflow that cut escalations by 70–80% and automated a documentation pipeline with Playwright screenshots. I redesigned a 200-article help portal with role-aware navigation and built a PDF pipeline that solved a years-long customer complaint. At Bird, I migrated 500+ Zendesk articles with conditional content and built an in-app help system from scratch. Every project required me to partner directly with Support and Engineering teams, lead technical discovery, and synthesize feedback into actionable improvements.

Your posting asks for someone who can lead customer deployments, triage technical blockers, and capture product gaps for Engineering. I have done exactly that. I would welcome the conversation.
